scientific_primary: Do seven-island BALA arthropod forests show within-transect temporal replacement beyond same-campaign split variation while between-transect spatial beta diversity takes contrasting trajectories for beetles vs spiders? Check robustness of island-equal spatial directions to one-island deletion WITHOUT any original species replay.

calculations_frozen_source_free.step_1: Verify 7 source island temporal Sørensen excess is positive in both guilds and source all-island mean agrees with original v1.316 stored numeric aggregate.
calculations_frozen_source_free.step_2: For each guild compute fixed source island-equal mean B3−B1 spatial Simpson and Sørensen beta from v1.318 frozen per-island values, compare exact stored means. Source pair n dependent, site n independent.
calculations_frozen_source_free.step_3: For all seven leave-one-island-out subsets, recompute source mean spatial Simpson beta independently for beetles and spiders. Report sign count and min/max LOO, NOT seven independent bootstrap replicates, no p-value.
calculations_frozen_source_free.step_4: Enumerate source island codes with Beetle spatial Simpson delta negative while mean source site-level Beetle alpha B3 exceeds B1. Report existing alpha and beta identities; no causal attribution to particular taxa.
calculations_frozen_source_free.step_5: Retain source v1.318 exact 9 pre-selected Event-ID salts ×2 complementary halves sign count (18/18 Beetles, 13/18 Spiders). These are NOT 18 independent biological replicates.
calculations_frozen_source_free.step_6: Report beta direction disagreement between guilds on same original island contexts; beware 29 vs 28 physical plots as not perfectly matched taxonomic full panel.

strongest_supported_claim: Beetle spatial Simpson beta island-equal trend remains negative after removing any one original island (descriptive source-free sensitivity), and both guilds show within-site temporal species replacement beyond within-campaign heterogeneity on all seven islands. Spider island-average spatial differentiation is not comparably robust.
no_inference: Do not infer a species-level identity or external-pool mechanism from source aggregate alone
Not a new independent field system, not experimental habitat forcing, not extinction/colonization or demographic rescue
No new significance claims from seven leave-one-out highly dependent subsets or 18 pseudo-independent half samples
Published 2026 BALA authors already report overall abundance/biomass/richness stability and species-specific trends; clearly cite as prior art
proposed_manuscript_scope: One original seven-island BALA long-term arthropod community study, focusing temporal species replacement and within-island spatial convergence, with source-independent SLAM/PRIBES context kept OUT of the main quantitative causal claim. Candidate Journal of Biogeography research paper, journal fit not a prediction of acceptance.
